scope: Split ('regular phase + championship/relegation groups') formats of the Austrian, Swiss, Danish, Czech, Slovak, Romanian and Bulgarian leagues in the 2026-27 season. Lower divisions are included and flagged when their label is coarse (no split at all).
conventions: precision=day means both the month and the day are verified in a source; precision=month means only the month is verified and the MM-DD is nominal (day 01 for a start, last day of the month for an end); precision=unknown means no date was found. Window-level precision is the weaker of start_precision/end_precision, which carry the per-date value. split_after_rounds is the round after which the table is cut. points_carry: full | half | none. Dates are 2026-27 unless stated otherwise.

leagues.name: Bundesliga
leagues.after: No final. The championship-group winner is champion and takes the first three European places; places 4 and 5 of the championship group plus the winner of the relegation group play a Conference League play-off for the last European spot. The last club of the relegation group is relegated directly (no relegation play-off).
leagues.quote: In der Saison 2026/27 treten zum neunten Mal seit der Saison 2018/19 zwölf Klubs in zunächst 22 Runden gegeneinander an. Jede Mannschaft spielt somit jeweils einmal zu Hause und auswärts gegen jede andere Mannschaft. Danach kommen die besten sechs Mannschaften in die Meistergruppe und die restlichen sechs in die Qualifikationsgruppe. Die Punkte aus dem Grunddurchgang werden erstmals nicht mehr halbiert und vollumfänglich in die Meister- bzw. Abstiegsrunde mitgenommen.
leagues.note: Rule change for 2026-27: point halving was abolished, so the old 'halved at the split' model is wrong for this season (bundesliga.at, 17 May 2026, cited in the article). Regular season 1 Aug 2026 - mid-March 2027; 6-team groups play a double round-robin (10 rounds, 32 in total - the article states the group sizes, not the group round count). Season ends 17 May 2027.

leagues.name: Super League
leagues.after: No title final. 12th is relegated directly; 11th plays the Challenge League runner-up over two legs (1 and 4 June 2027).
leagues.quote: In a first phase all twelve teams play each other three times each, for a total of 33 matchdays ... Following that, the league is split into two groups of six each, one championship group and one relegation group. ... Each team will play every other team in their group one time (five matches each), for a total of 38 matchdays. ... Points won in the first phase are carried over to the second phase.
leagues.note: Third season of this format (since 2023-24): triple round-robin (33), then 6+6 with a single round-robin (5) = 38. Winner of the championship group is Swiss champion. The season article prints '2026' in the phase dates (12 April / 25 April / 17 May) - read as 2027; it is also internally inconsistent about the last relegation-group matchday (27 May vs 4 June), so the split-window end uses the season end from the infobox (30 May 2027). German Wikipedia gives 25 July 2026 as the opening day against 24 July in the English infobox.

leagues.name: Challenge League
leagues.after: Champion promoted directly; runner-up plays the Super League 11th over two legs; bottom club relegated directly, no bottom play-off.
leagues.quote: The Challenge League is played over 36 rounds from the end of July to May, with a winter break from mid-December to the first week of February. Each team plays each other four times, twice at home and twice away, in a round-robin.
leagues.note: No split despite the country-level 'split' label: 10 clubs, quadruple round-robin (36 rounds), one table. The label in the window survey came from the Super League.

leagues.name: Promotion League
leagues.after: Champion promoted subject to licensing; bottom two relegated to the 1. Liga Classic. No play-off.
leagues.quote: Eighteen teams play each other twice, once home and once away, for a total of 34 games. The season begins in August and ends in May, interrupted through a winter break from late November to early March.
leagues.note: Level 3: 18 clubs, single double round-robin, no split. Reserve (U21) teams may play here but cannot be promoted. The 2026-27 fixture list runs 31 July 2026 - 29 May 2027.

leagues.name: Superliga
leagues.after: No final: championship-round winner is champion. Bottom two of the qualifying round are relegated directly (no relegation play-off). A separate single-leg European play-off matches the 4th of the championship round against the winner of the qualifying round (7th) for the last Conference League place.
leagues.quote: In both playoff groups, six teams play a full home-and-away schedule, resulting in ten matches (32 for the full season). All teams' points and goals carried over fully from the regular season into the playoffs.
leagues.note: Format since 2019-20: 12 clubs, 22 rounds, then 6+6 with 10 more (32 matches each), no halving. Season 24 July 2026 - 30 May 2027; the split falls in mid-March (the sources give the structure, not the split date).

leagues.name: 1. Division
leagues.after: No final. Top two of the promotion group are promoted to the Superliga; bottom two of the relegation group are relegated to the 2. Division, both directly.
leagues.quote: De 12 klubber møder indledningsvis hinanden to gange, én gang på hjemmebane og én gang på udebane, hvilket giver 22 spillerunder i grundspillet. Efter grundspillet går de seks bedst placerede hold videre til oprykningsspillet, mens de seks nederste hold fortsætter i nedrykningsspillet. Holdene medtager deres point og målscore fra grundspillet.
leagues.note: Second tier mirrors the Superliga: 12 clubs, 22 rounds, 6+6 with points AND goal difference carried, 32 matches in total (the 10 group rounds are derived from a 6-club double round-robin; the Danish article states the group sizes, not the count). Season 24 July 2026 - 31 May 2027.

leagues.name: 2. Division
leagues.after: No final. Top two of the promotion group are promoted to the 1. Division; bottom two of the relegation group are relegated to the 3. Division, both directly.
leagues.quote: De 12 klubber møder indledningsvis hinanden to gange, én gang på hjemmebane og én gang på udebane. Grundspillet består dermed af 22 spillerunder. Efter grundspillet går de seks bedst placerede klubber videre til oprykningsspillet, mens de seks nederste klubber fortsætter i nedrykningsspillet. Klubberne medtager deres point og målscore fra grundspillet.
leagues.note: Level 3, same 22+6/6 design with points and goal difference carried; 32 matches (10 group rounds derived). Season 31 July 2026 - June 2027 per the English infobox; the split date itself is not published in the sources read.

leagues.name: 3. Division
leagues.after: No final. Top two of the promotion group are promoted to the 2. Division; the bottom FOUR of the relegation group are relegated to the Denmark Series (only two of six survive).
leagues.quote: The 3rd Division is made up of a total of 12 clubs. After 22 rounds the group will be split in a promotion group and a relegation group. The top two teams of the promotion group will be promoted to the Danish 2nd Division, while the bottom four in the relegation group are relegated to the Denmark Series.
leagues.note: Level 4: the split exists but is the steepest cut in the pyramid (4 down). Round counts and dates are one season old in the base article and the 2026-27 season article gives no calendar, hence nulls.

leagues.name: Chance Liga
leagues.after: No final: the title goes to the team with the most total points including the regular season. Places 7-10 play a two-legged knockout (7v10, 8v9, final) for prize money and a better Czech Cup seeding - no European place. 16th is relegated directly; 14th and 15th play two-legged baráže against the 2nd and 3rd of the Chance Národní liga; 13th is always safe.
leagues.quote: Od sezóny 2018/19 po této třicetikolové základní části následuje na přelomu dubna a května nadstavbová část, ve které se týmy rozdělí na tři skupiny. Nejlepších šest týmů základní části postoupí do skupiny nadstavby o titul, skupina se hraje systémem každý s každým jednokolově. O titulu nerozhoduje kdo vyhraje zápasy v nadstavbě, ale ten kdo má nejvíce celkových bodů dohromady i se základní částí.
leagues.note: Three-way split, not two-way. Regular season: 25 July 2026 - 24 April 2027 (the official fixture list ends with round 30 on 24 April; round 18 on 12-14 December 2026). Nadstavba is single round-robin, so 5 rounds for the 6-club groups (35 matches max); its own fixture dates are not yet published (the stage-2 schedule page is empty).

leagues.name: Chance Národní liga
leagues.after: Champion promoted directly; 2nd and 3rd play two-legged baráže against the 14th and 15th of the Chance Liga; bottom two relegated. Promotion baráže on 3 and 6 June 2027.
leagues.quote: Účastní se jí 16 týmů, každý s každým hraje jednou na domácím hřišti a jednou na hřišti soupeře. Celkem se tedy hraje 30 kol. Mistrovský titul získává tým s nejvyšším počtem bodů v tabulce.
leagues.note: No split: 16 clubs, double round-robin, 30 rounds, one table. Calendar: round 1 on 25 July 2026, autumn ends with round 16 on 29 November 2026, spring starts with round 17 on 6 March 2027, promotion baráže 3 and 6 June 2027.

leagues.name: Niké liga
leagues.after: No final. Championship-group winner is champion. 12th is relegated directly; 11th plays the II. Liga runner-up over two legs (baráž) for the last place.
leagues.quote: In the current format, which has been in effect since the 2017–18 season, teams play home-and-away against every other team in the regular stage, for a total of 22 matches each. The table is then divided into two halves of 6 teams each – the top 6 play in the championship group and the bottom 6 play in the relegation group. Within these groups, teams again play home-and-away against each other, for a total of 10 matches each.
leagues.note: 12 clubs, 22 + 10 = 32 matches, points carried into the groups (the group table continues the same standings). Season 25-26 July 2026 to May 2027, no fixtures 13 December 2026 - 7 February 2027. The split date is not published in the sources read (month only).

leagues.name: II. Liga
leagues.after: Champion promoted subject to licensing; 2nd plays a two-legged play-off against the 11th of the Niké liga; bottom two relegated to the 3. Liga.
leagues.quote: Currently, the competition consists of 16 teams. Each season, the first-placed team in the 2. Liga is automatically promoted to the First League, subject to meeting league requirements. The team that finishes in second place enters a two-legged play-off against the second-to-last placed team from the First League, with the winner taking their place in the following season's First League. The two lowest-finishing teams in the 2. Liga are relegated to the 3. Liga.
leagues.note: No split: 16 clubs, 30 rounds, one table ('July 2026 - May 2027' is all the season article gives for the calendar). Reserve sides (Slovan B, Žilina B) cannot be promoted.

leagues.name: SuperLiga
leagues.after: No final: play-off winner is champion. 15th and 16th (9th and 10th of the play-out) are relegated directly; 13th and 14th (7th and 8th of the play-out) play two-legged baráže against the 3rd and 4th of the Liga II promotion play-off. A separate one-match European play-off (1st vs 2nd of the play-out, then against a play-off club) decides a Conference League place.
leagues.quote: Each team plays all other teams twice, resulting in 30 matches per club. After this regular season, teams are ranked by total points and split according to their position into either the championship play-offs or the relegation play-outs. At this stage, points are halved, and secondary criteria such as goal difference and goals scored are removed.
leagues.note: Points are halved (rounded up) and goal difference is reset at the split, so the play-off/play-out tables start from points only. Calendar from the Romanian article: winter break after round 21 (19-20 December 2026), play-off/play-out start 20-21 March 2027, play-out ends 22-23 May 2027, play-off a week later (season 29-30 May 2027).

leagues.name: Liga 2
leagues.after: No final. 1st and 2nd of the promotion play-off are promoted (subject to eligibility); 3rd and 4th play two-legged baráže against the 13th and 14th of the SuperLiga. Bottom two of each play-out group are relegated; the two 6th-placed play-out clubs meet in a play-off for the last relegation place.
leagues.quote: The format has been maintained, with a regular season contested by twenty-two teams in a single round-robin tournament. The top six teams at the end of the regular season advance to the promotion play-offs. The remaining sixteen teams will compete in the relegation play-outs, divided into two groups.
leagues.note: 22 clubs, single round-robin of 21 rounds (not double), then 6 + 8 + 8: the play-off plays 10 more (31 matches) and each play-out group 7 (28). Play-out seeding alternates by rank (7/10/11/14/15/18/19/22 and 8/9/12/13/16/17/20/21). Points are carried in full, unlike Liga I - the season article does not print this, it is the standing Liga II rule and matches the published tables. Promotion eligibility (licensing/legal status) can void a promotion.

leagues.name: efbet Liga
leagues.after: No final: championship-group winner is champion. The 3rd or 4th of the championship group plays the winner of the Conference League group in a single match for a European place. 14th is relegated directly; 12th and 13th play one-off baráže against the 2nd and 3rd of the Second League.
leagues.quote: Този сезон правилата за втората фаза на Efbet лига първенството след редовната фаза ще играе в: първа група – 4 отбора – от 1. до 4. място в редовния сезон; втора група – 4 отбора – от 5. до 8. място в редовния сезон; трета група – 6 отбора – от 9. до 14. място в редовния сезон. В първа и втора се играят шест кръга на принципа разменено гостуване, а 3-тият или 4-тият от първата група играе срещу 1-ия от втората група.
leagues.note: League cut from 16 to 14 clubs for 2026-27, so the old 30-round/8-team-relegation-halves model no longer applies: 26 rounds regular (double round-robin) then 4/4/6 with 6/6/5 rounds (32 or 31 matches). Calendar from the Bulgarian article: start 17-20 July 2026, last round of 2026 on 4-7 December, first round of 2027 on 12-15 February, season ends end of May 2027 with the Conference League baráž; the split month (April) is inferred from that calendar, not printed.

leagues.name: Vtora Liga
leagues.after: Champion promoted directly; 2nd and 3rd play one-off promotion ties against the 12th and 13th of the First League. Relegation: six direct (14th-20th as printed) plus 13th in a play-off against the Third League play-off winner.
leagues.quote: This season there will be 20 teams and there are some changes regarding promotion and relegation teams: At the top of the standings, the first respectively will win direct promotion to First League, while the 2nd and 3rd teams will play a play-off with the teams finishing 12th and 13th in the 2026/27 First League season.
leagues.note: No split. Transitional 20-club season (back to 16 in 2027-28), so 38 rounds is derived from a double round-robin of 20 - the article does not print the round count. The article says 'a total of 6 (from 14th to 20th place)', which is seven positions; the Bulgarian source (per the pyramid research) says five direct plus 13th, so the exact direct-relegation count is disputed. Dates: July 2026 - June 2027.

leagues.name: Česká fotbalová liga (ČFL, level 3, groups A+B)
leagues.after: No split. 32 clubs in two parallel groups of 16 (A and B), each a plain double round-robin. The two group winners meet in a baráž for the single promotion place to the Chance Národní liga; there is no overall champion. Relegation comes from the bottom of each group to Divize A/B/C, and the number of relegated ČFL clubs depends on how many Czech clubs drop from the 2. liga (four if two Czech clubs come down, three if one Czech and one Moravian, two if two Moravian).
leagues.quote: Liga bude pro tuto sezónu rozdělena na 2 skupiny po 16 týmech. Po skončení základní části se vítězové obou skupin utkají v baráži o jedno postupové místo do Chance Národní ligy. Každé mužstvo s každým soupeřem sehraje dvě utkání, a sice jednou na svém domácím hřišti a jednou na hřišti soupeřově.
leagues.note: Not a championship/relegation split despite the label: the 'groups' are two parallel 16-club divisions (since 2019-20), and the only post-season step is the promotion baráž between the two group winners (in 2025-26 both winners went up because the Národní liga had extra vacancies, which is why a baráž can look like a formality). 30 rounds is arithmetic from the quoted 16 clubs playing each other twice - the article prints neither the round count nor a calendar, hence null dates. The base article still says only the first-placed team is promoted, which is the pre-baráž rule text.

leagues.name: Moravskoslezská fotbalová liga (MSFL, level 3, Moravia)
leagues.after: No split: one 18-club table. The champion is promoted to the Chance Národní liga (subject to licensing); the bottom one to three clubs are relegated to Divize D/E/F depending on how many Moravian clubs come down from the 2. liga (three if two Moravian clubs drop, two if one Moravian and one Czech, one if two Czech).
leagues.quote: Tento ročník začal v srpnu 2026 a skončí v červnu 2027. Soutěže se od sezony 2019/20 účastní 18 týmů. Každé mužstvo s každým soupeřem sehraje dvě utkání, a sice jednou na svém domácím hřišti a jednou na hřišti soupeřově. Mistrem se stává tým s nejvyšším počtem bodů v tabulce.
leagues.note: Not a split league: MSFL is the Moravian half of level 3, a plain double round-robin with no groups. 34 rounds is arithmetic from the quoted 18 clubs playing each other twice (the article prints the club count, not the round count). Season August 2026 - June 2027, month precision only. The base article still credits the champion with direct promotion, while the 2026-27 ČFL article puts a baráž in front of the ČFL winners only - MSFL's champion is not part of that baráž.
